title: Data flow mapping
subtitle: <Application / Project name>
author: M. Cadoche
purpose: The purpose of this spreadsheet is to give a list of dependencies between the applications of our Information System.
objective: The objective of this spreadsheet is to provide the flow map with the DCP indicator. At this stage the flow map is constituted with the dependencies from our CMDB.
assumptions: By default the applications related to wholesale activity are tagged at DCP=No.
If the 2 apps carry DCPs then the flow carries DCP.
If one of the 2 does not carry a DCP then the flow does not carry DCP.
If DCP is Yes for the source app and DCP for the destination app is missing then the flow DCP is Yes.
method: If DCP=Yes in GDPR files and DCP=Yes in ARIS file then DCP reviewed = Yes.
If DCP in GDPR files differs from DCP in ARIS files then DCP reviewed = 'to be confirmed by an expert'.
If DCP in GDPR files is missing then DCP reviewed = DCP in ARIS files.
If DCP in ARIS files is missing then DCP reviewed = DCP in GDPR files.
If DCP in GDPR files and DCP in ARIS files are both missing then DCP reviewed = 'to be confirmed by an expert'.
